name: Elder Graveborn
summary: Near Brill, Elder Graveborn welcomes travelers for the Lunar Festival. This ancestral spirit honors them and directs pilgrims to other elders across northern Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Spirit in Tirisfal
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Graveborn greets travelers just southeast of Brill. The spectral elder stands in the haunted woods of Tirisfal Glades, with the Forsaken town nearby. Though the kingdom is troubled, Graveborn offers pilgrims peaceful greetings and ancestral wisdom. He also directs them to spirits in the Undercity, the Sepulcher, and across the Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Elder Graveborn appears as an ancestral ghost during the Lunar Festival. In Tirisfal Glades, just southeast of Brill, he gives travelers festival blessings.

faq.q: Why is he in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, ancestral spirits gather across Azeroth to honor past heroes and shared heritage. Elder Graveborn watches over the land outside Brill.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak to him?
faq.answer: Yes. Festival elders welcome travelers from either faction. Alliance travelers should approach carefully because Graveborn stands close to the Forsaken town of Brill.

faq.q: What information does he offer travelers?
faq.answer: Elder Graveborn points pilgrims toward other local spirits. He names the Undercity, the Sepulcher in Silverpine, Light's Hope Chapel, the Weeping Cave, and Scholomance.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can find Graveborn on the road between Brill and the Undercity. His presence recalls Azeroth's ancient past, untouched by the Scourge or the blight.
As an Alliance pilgrim, you must skirt Brill to reach Graveborn without drawing the attention of Forsaken guards and patrols.
